# Transport MCP connectors

3 transport connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All transport connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/transport](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/transport).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Deutsche Bahn Fahrplan](connectors/deutsche-bahn.md) | German train timetable with live delays: search stations, list departures and arrivals with real-time delay, track and cancellation status, and plan journeys between any two stations. | 5 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/deutsche-bahn-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-to-muse) |
| [Deutsche Bahn Timetables API](connectors/deutsche-bahn-timetables.md) | Deutsche Bahn's official station-board API (DB API Marketplace, CC BY 4.0): find stations by name or EVA number, read the planned hourly timetable of any station, and pull the live change feed — … | 4 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-deutsche-bahn-timetables-to-muse) |
| [Georgian Railway](connectors/georgian-railway.md) | Search Georgian Railway (საქართველოს რკინიგზა) passenger trains: find stations, look up services between any two stations on a given date, and read live seat availability and fares in GEL. | 3 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/georgian-railway-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-georgian-railway-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-georgian-railway-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-georgian-railway-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-georgian-railway-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-georgian-railway-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-georgian-railway-to-muse) |
